page: Microsoft Azure DC64as_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCasv6 server family. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external volumes. It is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance persistent disks. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

Given the balanced allocation of compute and memory resources, the DC64as_v6 is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suited for applications such as multi-threaded enterprise applications, web serving, and medium-sized databases that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable performance for sustained workloads, offering a stable resource density profile for enterprise deployments.
